DML.SELECT: SELECT parent_element_type_id as "parentElementTypeId", parent_element_id as "parentElementId", child_element_type_id as "childElementTypeId", child_element_id as "childElementId", child_inheritable_state_id as "childInheritableStateId", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM conf.element_hierarchies WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.element_hierarchies (parent_element_type_id, parent_element_id, child_element_type_id, child_element_id, child_inheritable_state_id, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:parentElementTypeId, :parentElementId, :childElementTypeId, :childElementId, :childInheritableStateId, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM conf.element_hierarchies WHERE parent_element_type_id = :parentElementTypeId AND parent_element_id = :parentElementId AND child_element_type_id = :childElementTypeId AND child_element_id = :childElementId
